how_to_choose: Pick one option per suggestion. Reply with the suggestion ID and option letter, e.g. 'S-01 A'. Nothing below is implemented until a choice is recorded. Recommendations are judgements and are labelled as such.

suggestions.suggestion: Resolve whether GitHub Pages fits this commercial site before growing it.
suggestions.evidence: GitHub's limits page restricts Pages for sites primarily directed at commercial transactions (FLG-R09).

options.label: Keep on GitHub Pages and ask GitHub Support for a view
options.tradeoff: No change in build. Risk remains until GitHub answers.

options.label: Move the built site to another static host that allows affiliate sites
options.tradeoff: Needs a host chosen and checked against its terms. No host is named here because none was verified.

options.label: Keep Pages but limit it to editorial content and remove the purchase links
options.tradeoff: Lower risk, but the brief's purpose (buying) is lost.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A first, because it costs nothing to ask. This is a judgement.

suggestions.suggestion: Choose the analytics path before any event is recorded.
suggestions.evidence: No endpoint is available on Pages (SRC-07, SRC-08). The five events are not defined in the brief (Q-07).

options.label: No analytics. Keep the event code off.
options.tradeoff: Privacy-first. No data on clicks until a choice is made.

options.label: Self-hosted endpoint on a server or function host that the owner controls
options.tradeoff: Gives first-party click counts. Needs hosting, a privacy notice and maintenance.

options.label: Third-party analytics with consent
options.tradeoff: Quick to set up. Needs a consent banner and a provider agreement.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A until the owner decides on B or C. This is a judgement.

suggestions.suggestion: Confirm the product set before writing more guides.
suggestions.evidence: Three observed products are air fryers, one is a thermometer, and one is unresolved (FLG-R07, Q-01).

options.label: Keep all five. Add a thermometer guide later.
options.tradeoff: Broad set. The thermometer has no guide yet.

options.label: Focus on the three air fryers. Hold the thermometer and the unresolved link.
options.tradeoff: Tighter topic. Fewer products on the site until Q-01 is answered.

options.label: Hold the unresolved P-04 until its destination is confirmed. Keep the rest.
options.tradeoff: Removes the only link that cannot be resolved, without changing the other four.

suggestions.recommendation: Option C now, with B if the owner wants a single category. This is a judgement.

suggestions.suggestion: Set a cadence so the next guide is planned, not improvised.
suggestions.evidence: No cadence was supplied (FLG-R13). The feed and sitemap update on every build.

options.label: One guide every two weeks
options.tradeoff: Steady output. Needs an owner or editor for each one.

options.label: One guide a month
options.tradeoff: Lower load. Slower feedback from measured queries.

options.label: Publish when there is a measured question to answer
options.tradeoff: Matches the brief's measure-first aim. Output is irregular.

suggestions.recommendation: Option B until query data exists, then review. This is a judgement.

suggestions.suggestion: Name who is responsible for the content.

options.label: Keep pages unsigned, with an editorial note
options.tradeoff: No invented person. Less personal trust.

options.label: Owner supplies a real name and role for the byline
options.tradeoff: Clear accountability. Owner must confirm the name is true.

options.label: Publish a reviewer statement without a named author
options.tradeoff: Shows review process. Needs a written process behind it.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A until the owner supplies a name. This is a judgement.

suggestions.evidence: The site uses typography and text only. Product images are not included in this build. The Operating Agreement defines Program Content and limits its use (SRC-01, Section 1).

options.label: Keep typography only
options.tradeoff: No image rights question. Less visual.

options.label: Owner supplies licensed photos
options.tradeoff: Strong visual identity. Owner must hold the rights.

options.label: Use Associates Program Content images, where the Agreement permits
options.tradeoff: Needs a check of the permitted use in the Agreement.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A now. This is a judgement.

suggestions.suggestion: Decide whether readers see prices at all.
suggestions.evidence: No price was verified for any product (FLG-R06, Q-05).

options.label: No prices. Readers see the product page.
options.tradeoff: Nothing to go stale. Less useful at a glance.

options.label: Dated price snapshot, labelled with the observation date and source
options.tradeoff: Useful. Goes stale; needs a refresh routine.

options.label: Live price from an authorized product data feed
options.tradeoff: Most current. Needs an authorized data source (Q-14).

suggestions.recommendation: Option A now. Option B once snapshots are taken with dates. This is a judgement.

suggestions.suggestion: Choose the next guide topics from measured queries, not from the working titles.
suggestions.evidence: No query or site data exists yet (Q-12). Search Console is not connected (FLG-R11).

options.label: Verify Search Console, then pick topics after 60 days of data
options.tradeoff: Evidence-led. Slow to start.

options.label: Pick topics from the four working titles now and review later
options.tradeoff: Fast. Not measured.

options.label: Pick topics from manual observation of buyer questions, dated and sourced
options.tradeoff: Some evidence, but a manual process to keep up.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A, with B for the first batch already published. This is a judgement.

suggestions.suggestion: Decide whether the disclosure should be stronger than the required sentence.
suggestions.evidence: The Associates sentence is required (SRC-01, Section 5). The Associates Help page asks for a link-level disclosure too (SRC-03). The FTC asks for disclosures that are hard to miss (SRC-05).

options.label: Keep the required sentence, the '(paid link)' label, and the sponsored attribute
options.tradeoff: Meets the sources as read. Current build.

options.label: Add a plain sentence at the top of each guide: 'I earn a commission on qualifying purchases made through the links in this guide.'
options.tradeoff: Clearer for readers. Needs the owner to confirm it is true.

options.label: Add a disclosure box in each guide that states the relationship in full
options.tradeoff: Most explicit. Heavier layout.

suggestions.recommendation: Option B, once the owner confirms the sentence. This is a judgement.

suggestions.evidence: The brief refers to five defined events but does not name them (Q-07). Five are proposed on the Measurement page.

options.label: Adopt the proposed five: page_view, product_view, guide_view, outbound_click, feed_click
options.tradeoff: Covers reach, interest, click-through and feed use.

options.label: Owner supplies a different five
options.tradeoff: Matches the brief exactly, once supplied.

options.label: Record only outbound_click
options.tradeoff: Smallest footprint. No reach data.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A, subject to S-02. This is a judgement.

suggestions.suggestion: Keep one navigation group and move dashboards to the footer.
suggestions.evidence: The brief asks for a single navigation group, with every dashboard reachable from the footer.

options.label: One header group: Products, Categories, Guides, Executive summary. All dashboards in the footer.
options.tradeoff: Matches the brief. Current build.

options.label: Header shows dashboards too
options.tradeoff: Easier to reach. Crowds the reader-facing menu.

suggestions.suggestion: Confirm the branch model once the single-branch constraint allows it.
suggestions.evidence: The brief asks for session-<id>/<task> branches and an integration branch. This session is limited to one branch (FLG-R15).

options.label: Keep one branch per session
options.tradeoff: Simple. Other sessions' work must be merged by hand.

options.label: Adopt session-<id>/<task> branches and an integration branch
options.tradeoff: Matches the brief. More merges to manage.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A for this site. This is a judgement.
